ordered_refusals.label: unattributed
ordered_refusals.message: the probe answered but named no owner: a health answer proves liveness, not which engine served it

ordered_refusals.label: same-owner-on-both-sides
ordered_refusals.message: both sides of the differential name the same owner: this is one engine measured twice, not a comparison

ordered_refusals.label: same-selection-on-both-sides
ordered_refusals.message: both sides of the differential name the same engine selection: a differential compares two different engines

ordered_refusals.label: matrix-subset-incomplete
ordered_refusals.message: the differential matrix declares a subset missing [SessionList]: a matrix measured below its minimum subset claims parity it did not measure

ordered_refusals.label: operation-declared-twice
ordered_refusals.message: the differential matrix declares v2.health.get twice: one operation cannot stand in for another

ordered_refusals.label: subset-declared-for-another-matrix
ordered_refusals.message: a subset declared for the sleep-resume matrix cannot be planned as restart: a matrix must be measured by its own subset

ordered_refusals.label: matrix-evidence-mismatch
ordered_refusals.message: restart evidence cannot support a differential plan: each matrix carries its own evidence

ordered_refusals.label: bound-not-reported-by-host
ordered_refusals.message: the bound max_request_head_bytes was asserted-by-driver rather than reported by the host receipt: a differential records the engine's bounds, it does not state them

ordered_refusals.label: bound-set-incomplete
ordered_refusals.message: the host bound recording is missing [MaxHeaders, ShutdownDrainAllowance]: an unrecorded bound is a gap, not a default

ordered_refusals.label: bound-recorded-twice
ordered_refusals.message: the bound max_connections was recorded twice: one reading cannot stand in for another

ordered_refusals.label: bound-rendering-empty
ordered_refusals.message: the bound max_connections was recorded with an empty rendering: an empty value records nothing while looking like a reading

ordered_refusals.label: restart-kept-the-instance-identity
ordered_refusals.message: the observed instance identity is unchanged across the boundary: an engine that kept its ServiceInstanceId did not restart

ordered_refusals.label: restart-changed-the-slot
ordered_refusals.message: the observed slot changed across the boundary: a different registration slot is a different service, not a restart

ordered_refusals.label: resume-reused-the-recorded-receipt
ordered_refusals.message: resume reused the recorded receipt: crossing a sleep boundary must re-admit from a fresh probe, not assume the recorded attachment survived

ordered_refusals.label: long-session-reads-unbounded
ordered_refusals.message: the long-session matrix declared zero maximum reads: `long` is stated in counts and bytes, and an unbounded count is not a bound

ordered_refusals.label: long-session-bytes-unbounded
ordered_refusals.message: the long-session matrix declared zero maximum bytes: `long` is stated in counts and bytes, and an unbounded budget is not a bound

ordered_refusals.label: leaves-selector-attached
ordered_refusals.message: the plan leaves the selector attached: a differential run must return the desktop to its retained engine, never strand it on one it was borrowing

ordered_refusals.label: not-the-recorded-owner
ordered_refusals.message: the observed owner is not the owner this selection recorded: the recorded attachment is stale and must be re-admitted, not reused

ordered_refusals.label: restart-changed-the-environment
ordered_refusals.message: the observed environment receipt changed across the boundary: an owner differing in environment is a replacement on the same slot, not a restart

ordered_refusals.label: matrix-evidence-names-another-engine
ordered_refusals.message: the matrix evidence does not describe one engine this plan admitted: a restart or resume of some other service is not evidence about either engine under comparison

ordered_refusals.label: matrix-evidence-names-another-engine
ordered_refusals.message: the matrix evidence does not describe one engine this plan admitted: a restart or resume of some other service is not evidence about either engine under comparison

ordered_refusals.label: matrix-evidence-names-another-engine
ordered_refusals.message: the matrix evidence does not describe one engine this plan admitted: a restart or resume of some other service is not evidence about either engine under comparison

ordered_refusals.label: resume-contradicts-the-admitted-pairing
ordered_refusals.message: the resume evidence attributes an admitted owner receipt to an engine it was not admitted as: two halves agreeing on the wrong engine agree about nothing that matters
